notes.title: V1.0.1 - Fixed blank screenshots on windows 11
notes.content:
Addresses an issue where screenshots taken within Steam interface come out blank. Not sure how long this has been an issue for as there are screenshots uploaded recently to all the hubs. Hopefully this fixes it, but it will only apply to the current releases going forwards. 

[h3]CHANGELOG:[/h3]
FIXED - Blank screenshots when pressing F12
